title: Symmetrical Variation (1...c5)
intro: Black mirrors 1.c4 with 1...c5. Fianchetto with g3 and Bg2, develop Nf3, and meet an early ...d5 with cxd5.

lessons.title: The Fianchetto set-up
lessons.summary: Play Nc3, g3, Bg2 and Nf3 against 1...c5.

steps.text: Against the Symmetrical English (1...c5), the fianchetto with Nc3, g3 and Bg2 gives White a solid, flexible game.
Answer 1...c5 and 2...Nc6 with Nc3 and g3.
steps.ifRight: Your bishop is ready for g2.

steps.text: Black develops 5...Nf6. Get your king to safety.
steps.ifRight: Now White can play d3 or d4 next.

lessons.title: Meeting an early ...d5
lessons.summary: Trade on d5 and gain time with Bg2.

steps.text: If Black plays ...Nf6 early, they often strike in the centre with 3...d5.

steps.ifWrong: Play 4.cxd5 so Black loses central pawn presence.
steps.ifRight: After ...Nxd5, your bishop will hit the knight.

steps.text: Develop the bishop onto the long diagonal with tempo.
steps.ifWrong: Play 5.Bg2, attacking the knight on d5.
steps.ifRight: Black usually retreats the knight to c7.

steps.text: Black retreats with 5...Nc7 to keep the c-file guarded.
Develop your king's knight and control d4 and e5.
steps.ifRight: Next come O-O, d3 and Be3, pressing on c5.

lessons.title: Middlegame plans
lessons.summary: Choose between the calm d3 flank attack and the central d4 break.

steps.text: In the Symmetrical English, White can either hold the centre with d3 and expand with Rb1 and b4, or break at once with d4.
Play the calm move that prepares a3, Rb1 and b4 while opening the c1 bishop.
steps.ifWrong: Play 7.d3 to build a solid structure.
steps.ifRight: White prepares Bd2, a3, Rb1 and b4.

feedback.d2d4: 7.d4 is strong too. Here we focus on the solid 7.d3 plan.

steps.hint: Support b4 with the rook on b1 or pawn on a3.
steps.ifWrong: Play 8.Rb1 (or 8.a3) to get ready for b4.
steps.ifRight: Once b4 lands, White gains space on the queenside.

steps.text: In the same position, White can also strike at once in the centre. Play that break.
steps.ifWrong: Play 7.d4 to open lines in the centre.
steps.ifRight: After 7...cxd4 8.Nxd4, White gets active piece play.

steps.ifWrong: Play 8.Nxd4 so your bishop on g2 stays open.
steps.ifRight: Your pieces control the centre and long diagonal.
